facts.claim: In 1885, the three regiments of Silahdars in Bangalore, Mysore, and Shimoga were reduced to two regiments with a total strength of 1,171.
facts.quote: In 1885 the three regiments of Silahdars, stationed at Bangalore, Mysore and Shimoga, with detach- ments at other District headquarters, w^ere reduced to two, with a total strength of 1,171

facts.claim: In 1892, the two regiments were broken up and two new corps were formed, with final sanction granted in July 1893.
facts.quote: In 1892 the two regiments were broken up and two fresh corps formed, as finally sanctioned in July 1893

facts.claim: The actual strength of the two regiments in 1895 was 1,194 in total.
facts.quote: The actual strength of the two regiments in 1895 was : Imperial Service Regiment, 645 ; Local Service Regiment, 549 ; or 1,194 altogether.
